tool.name: Praat
tool.command:
export HOME=\$PWD && mkdir -p ./inputs ./outputs && chown 1000:1000 ./inputs || true && ## the app user of the container (in NFS export with root-shash this will fail and is not needed) chown 1000:1000 ./outputs || true && ## the app user of the container (in NFS export with root-shash this will fail and is not needed) echo "=== Process identity ===" && echo "User ID: " && id -u && echo "Group ID: " && id -g &&
echo "=== Current directory ===" && pwd &&
echo "=== Directory permissions ===" && ls -ld / /config ./inputs ./outputs && echo "=== Directory contents ===" && ls -l ./inputs && ls -l ./outputs && ls -l /config &&
#if $datasets #for $i, $dataset in enumerate($datasets) cp '$dataset' '/config/dataset_${i}.${dataset.ext}' && #end for #end if ls -l ./inputs &&
echo "=== Starting /init with debugging ===" && /bin/sh -x /init 2>&1
rc=\$? echo "=== /init exited with code: \$rc ===" exit "\$rc" praat --version > version.txt && /init

param.name: datasets
param.label: Files to open in Praat
param.help: Select audio, TextGrids, or other Praat-readable files. Files open automatically when the desktop starts.

tool.help:
Praat provides interactive speech analysis, visualization, and annotation.
Launch this tool and open the desktop from Active Interactive Tools. Selected files are copied into the inputs directory and opened automatically. They have numbered filenames; your original Galaxy datasets are not modified.
Save results directly in the outputs directory, then choose Quit in Praat. The container finishes and Galaxy collects the saved files into a collection. Saving an input file in inputs does not include it in the output collection. Closing the browser tab leaves the desktop running.
Browser audio is enabled in the image. If playback is silent, enable audio in the web interface and select PulseAudio under Praat's Sound playing preferences. Browser microphone recording is not provided by this setup.
